Hello everyone , I am  Dr Natasha Sunil Kove Livestock Development Officer ( Grade 1) (Maharashtra govt)
BVSC &AH , MVSC ( ICAR-NDRI) JRF scholar
Registered Veterinary Practitioner
Enthusiast to make complex topics easy for you.

 I welcome you all to my channel. Thank you in advance for visiting the description page .🎉🎉
******************
Motive of the channel:
1) Veterinary Science lectures for Veterinary graduate students
2) Guidance for student considering Veterinary as a profession
3) Upsc aspirants taking Veterinary Science as optional
4) Information related to field to Animal lovers

**********
I hope you would love the guidance.

Like  👍Share ❤️ and Subscribe 🙏to the channel for regular updates.

Thank you for watching the videos. Need Your genuine support 🙏 I am here to help you learn veterinary science easily ⭐

Dr Natasha Kove 
MSVC Reg : 10188
VCI Reg : 12653

For business enquiries feel free to contact on vetoptionalupsc@gmail.com
